original.target_description: Problem 10: Predicted summer-goal achievement: monthly subgoals Jill versus daily subgoals Tina.

es.quote:
Who is more likely to reach her overall goal for the summer?
      Please circle one: Jill (22%) Tina (78%)

   Both runners have the same overall goal for the summer. However, Jill
has divided her overall goal into distant subgoals of 330 miles per month,
while Tina has divided her overall goal into proximal subgoals of 11 miles
per day. People agree that the proximal subgoals are more likely to produce
eventual success.
